name: Cardboard box
description: Experience the extraordinary in the ordinary with this 3D photogrammetry model of a cardboard box. This meticulously crafted digital replica reveals the subtle textures, folds, and details of a commonplace item often overlooked. Ideal for various applications, from realistic game environments to packaging design and educational visuals, this model adds authenticity and versatility to your projects. Download now and explore the intricate beauty hidden within the simplicity of a cardboard box.
